The journey of RC17 officially got underway with a traditional pooja ceremony. According to an official press release issued by the makers, the grand muhurat event was scheduled to take place on Sunday directly on the film's set.

The production team confirmed the commencement of work with an enthusiastic caption accompanying their social media announcement, officially welcoming the megastar and the director to the new venture.

Looking Back At Rangasthalam

The monumental success of Rangasthalam remains a key milestone in both Ram Charan's and Sukumar's careers. The 2018 rural drama captivated audiences globally and crossed a phenomenal milestone by earning over Rs 210 crore at the worldwide box office.

That film starred Samantha Ruth Prabhu alongside Charan and featured Jagapathi Babu as the formidable, corrupt village president Phanindra Bhupathi, whose thirty-year tyranny drove the narrative.

Plot And Character Legacy Of Rangasthalam

Rangasthalam centered around a village subjected to intimidation, land seizures, and debt exploitation under an autocratic leader. The core storyline ignited when Charan's character sought vengeance for the brutal murder of his elder brother, Kumar Babu, who had fought to protect the village.

The gripping narrative and raw rural backdrop established a high benchmark for regional cinema that later crossed boundaries to achieve widespread national and international appreciation.

Before embarking on this new pan-India undertaking, Ram Charan was recently seen starring in the film Peddi. In that project, he portrayed a dedicated laborer in 1980s rural Andhra Pradesh.

His role in Peddi highlighted a character who successfully overcomes a severe physical injury to transform into a dedicated track athlete, further showcasing his versatility as a leading actor.

ld.articleBody:
The Initial Performer Announcement

Organizers for South Korea's prominent year-end music special have officially released their very first wave of performing artists. Announced in mid-November, the initial roster brings together a dynamic mix of established veterans and contemporary breakout stars to deliver a memorable live experience.

The event is slated to draw massive attention from global music enthusiasts eager to see how the diverse lineup will collaborate and perform on one major platform.

A Multi-Generational Lineup

The unveiled roster spans multiple eras of the Korean music industry, ensuring a broad appeal across different generations of fans. Longstanding solo powerhouses like Kim Jae Joong and CL stand alongside accomplished vocal groups such as MAMAMOO and Soyeon of i-dle.

Representing newer generations of the K-pop scene are popular groups like TXT and NMIXX. Additionally, three newer musical entities—A2O MAY, A2O LITE, and A2O SOUL—complete this initial phase of the performer list.

Schedule and Venue Details

Audiences planning to attend or tune into the broadcast can mark their calendars for December 18, 2026. The live show will commence at 7 p.m. local Korean Standard Time.

The festivities will take place at the KBS Arena located in Seoul, serving as the central hub for the year-end celebration.

Global Viewing and Broadcasting

For international supporters wanting to catch the action from abroad, the evening start time translates to different local hours depending on the region. In European time zones, for instance, 7 p.m. KST converts to 11:00 CET or 10:00 GMT.

Official KBS channels are expected to release specific regional streaming details and broadcasting schedules as the event date draws closer.

History of the KBS Special

The annual music festival holds a long-standing tradition within South Korea's broadcasting history. Originally launched back in 1965, the program started out as an awards ceremony.

Broadcasters eventually phased out competitive awards for the event in 2006, transitioning the format permanently into a celebratory year-end music festival.

What to Expect on Stage

Year-end music festivals in South Korea are widely known for offering unique production elements that viewers typically do not see on regular weekly music programs. Fans frequently anticipate exclusive collaborative performances and special stages.

This initial announcement acts as the first preview, encouraging followers to watch for upcoming announcements regarding additional performers and program segments.

The upcoming cinematic retelling of the traditional Hindu epic Ramayana is generating tremendous excitement across domestic and international markets. Produced by Namit Malhotra, the feature is scheduled to arrive in cinema halls on November 5, 2026, positioning itself strategically just ahead of the festive season. Billed as the most expensive Indian movie ever produced, the project unites a massive star-studded cast, leading technical personnel, top-tier visual effects specialists, and prominent music composers.

With advance ticket sales officially underway, industry participants and moviegoers alike are closely monitoring the mythological project. The narrative explores the timeless tale of good triumphing over evil, aiming to captivate audiences worldwide through a modern yet culturally grounded lens.

Trade Gurus Eye Rs 100 Crore Plus On Day One

Industry experts have begun offering their projections regarding the feature's commercial viability and opening-day potential. Noted trade figure Akkshay Rathie believes that the intrinsic financial capability of the venture is limitless, noting that the domestic market alone could witness collections between Rs 100 crore and Rs 125 crore on its first day across all languages.

Regarding international markets, Rathie notes that performance will heavily rely on Sony's distribution strategy, the specific territories secured, and the inclusion of non-traditional cinema chains. Engaging audiences beyond the traditional Indian diaspora will also dictate the film's overseas trajectory.

Caution Advised Over Early Projections

While enthusiasm remains high, veteran trade analyst and film critic Taran Adarsh suggests that it is currently premature to pinpoint an exact opening figure. Adarsh points out that advance bookings have only commenced at selective theater locations so far.

Furthermore, final show schedules and screen allocations remain unfinalized, meaning that spot bookings will heavily influence the definitive box office tallies recorded on the day of release.

Navigating The Diwali Holiday Window

Industry expert Girish Johar offers additional perspective by highlighting the specific calendar layout surrounding the premiere. Because the theatrical run begins on a Thursday and the festival falls on a Sunday, the core commercial momentum is expected to accelerate significantly from Sunday onward.

Despite the pre-Diwali Thursday launch, Johar remains encouraged by early advance booking trends. He projects a domestic opening of around Rs 50 crore across all languages, alongside an anticipated opening weekend total scaling up to Rs 250 crore.

The feature boasts an impressive roster of acting talent, prominently featuring Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi in pivotal roles. Observers emphasize that the collaborative effort involves top-tier professionals across every department of filmmaking.

Director Nitesh Tiwari is being singled out as a filmmaker to watch closely throughout this release cycle. Early trade intelligence and positive overseas preview feedback suggest that the production possesses strong legs for a sustained box office run.

ld.articleBody:
The Grand Arrival of an Epic

The most expensive film in Indian cinematic history has officially made its way to theaters worldwide. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana Part 1 brings the timeless mythological narrative to the big screen with unprecedented production scale and financial backing. Produced by Namit Malhotra's Prime Focus Studios alongside Yash, the project marks a massive milestone for Indian cinema, capturing widespread attention from global audiences, critics, and industry insiders alike.

Based on Valmiki's epic text while also drawing elements from Tulsidas' Ramcharitmanas, the feature film has generated immense anticipation over the years. With paid preview screenings already held in the United States and Canada ahead of the wide theatrical launch on November 5, 2026, the ambitious adaptation is poised to establish new box office benchmarks both domestically and internationally.

Star-Studded Cast and Crew

The mythological project features a prominent ensemble cast headlined by Ranbir Kapoor portraying Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi stepping into the role of Sita, and Yash taking on the mantle of the antagonist Ravana. The expansive roster also includes notable performances by Ravie Dubey, Rakul Preet Singh, Arun Govil, Lara Dutta, Vivek Oberoi, Kunal Kapoor, Adinath Kothare, Kajal Aggarwal, and Anupam Kher. Meanwhile, Sunny Deol is cast as Lord Hanuman, though his character is reportedly reserved for the second installment.

Behind the camera, the film unites top-tier talent from across the globe. Director Nitesh Tiwari co-wrote the screenplay alongside Shridhar Raghavan. In a historic collaboration, legendary composers A.R. Rahman and Hans Zimmer joined forces to create the musical score, while visual effects were handled by DNEG, an eight-time Oscar-winning studio managed by Namit Malhotra.

Unprecedented Budget and Global Scale

Ramayana Part 1 has been mounted on a reported staggering budget of 1600 crore rupees, comfortably surpassing any prior financial investment in an Indian motion picture. To match this colossal investment, the production has secured a massive global distribution footprint across 70,000 screens. Sony Pictures is managing international distribution outside of India, whereas Dharma Productions is overseeing theatrical distribution within the Hindi-speaking market.

Because both celebrities maintain residences in Miami, their proximity has provided a convenient backdrop for their budding romance.

Sources indicate that Swanepoel has remained particularly selective and guarded, confiding in only a very tight circle of confidants about her ongoing relationship with the former athlete.

Background on Past Relationships and Families

Tom Brady has navigated a highly publicized dating life since finalizing his divorce from supermodel Gisele Bündchen in 2022. The retired quarterback shares two children, Benjamin and Vivian, with Bündchen, and another son, Jack, with his former partner Bridget Moynahan. The revelation of the romance first emerged during the weekend, quickly drawing widespread interest from pop culture observers and media outlets alike. Representatives for both Brady and Swanepoel have not immediately offered public comments regarding the reports. The tight-lipped nature of their outings reflects a mutual desire to keep their private lives shielded from the relentless glare of celebrity journalism.

Earlier in January, Brady addressed his personal schedule when questioned about his dating life following a New Year's Eve sighting.
